cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a sunny enclosed veranda with drying racks overhead — standing; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing with one foot up on a step; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — perched on a ledge or edge; A century-old lakeside bathhouse with a dry pebble path cut between two shallow pools — She tests the rhythm of seven skipping stones by laying them out from smallest to largest along the warm coping; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds her keepsake up beside her face; A disused stained-glass workshop with a broad bay window and bins of coloured glass offcuts — She holds two glass offcuts together and projects the colours onto a blank page to choose a visual rhythm for her next verse; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a lit dance stage or milonga floor — kneeling on the ground; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — lying on her front; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; a wooden river dock above calm water — rests a fishing rod against her shoulder; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — rests the pen from a notebook against her lips
